# opnsense_netflow_settings (Resource)

NetFlow export and local collection (**Reporting ▸ NetFlow**). When `collect_enable` is set, OPNsense adds the local collector `127.0.0.1:2056` to `capture_targets`; include it in the configuration to avoid a diff. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `netflow_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_netflow_settings.this
  id = "netflow_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_netflow_settings" "this" {
  capture_interfaces = ["lan"]
  capture_version    = "v9"
  capture_targets    = ["10.0.10.50:2055"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active_timeout` (Number) Split long running flows into smaller parts. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `capture_egress_only` (Set of String) Select interfaces used for WAN traffic to avoid counting NAT traffic twice.
- `capture_interfaces` (Set of String) Select all the interfaces to enable NetFlow on.
- `capture_targets` (Set of String) Select destinations to send NetFlow data to (ip address:port, eg 192.168.0.1:2550).
- `capture_version` (String) Select NetFlow version to use. One of `v5`, `v9`.
- `collect_enable` (Boolean) Collect NetFlow data on this firewall for use with Insight. Note that the local cache only holds the latest 100 MB of data.
- `inactive_timeout` (Number) Expire idle flows. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `netflow_settings`.
